title: DHCPv6: Don't stop the entire packet for an error in encapsulated option
description:
Cf. 9e2658ed78291915219fae3824e856771a6bfe95, the at_end flag was not
reset. We don't need the at_end flag at all - instead of returning zero
we can return the remaining length, and all the loops and tests work.

Fix #21160
